description: The iPhone 18 Pro Max is a refined flagship rather than a major leap over the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Its familiar design and excellent display remain largely unchanged, while the A20 Pro delivers effortless performance and manageable heat during demanding games. The variable-aperture camera adds welcome creative control, and iOS 27 brings a refreshed interface with a slight learning curve. Battery life is the standout: it lasted nearly a day and a half in our testing, comfortably outlasting its predecessor. At a starting price of Rs. 1,79,900, it suits older iPhone owners more than recent upgraders.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Review: Powerful, Polished, but Who Should Actually Upgrade?

description: Android and iPhone users can manage which apps have access to their location through their phone's privacy settings. Both platforms let users block location access entirely or allow it only while an app is in use. They also offer options to limit access to precise location, where supported. However, restricting location permissions does not prevent every form of location estimation, as apps may still use information such as an IP address. Reviewing app permissions can help users decide which apps need location access.
title: How to Turn Off Location Tracking for Apps on Android and iOS

description: Prominent Android brands have introduced several premium handsets in India with advanced chipsets, high-refresh-rate displays, versatile camera systems, and fast-charging support. Some models come with inbuilt gaming features. Buyers spending under Rs. 80,000 can choose from models like Realme GT 8 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Vivo V80, Motorola Signature, and Oppo Reno 16.
title: Best Smartphones Under Rs. 80,000 in India: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Reno 16, More

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro Max are Oppo and Apple's latest flagship smartphones that were recently launched in India. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is equipped with a 6.78-inch Full-HD+ (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 144Hz. The iPhone 18 Pro Max boasts a 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with ProMotion technology that enables a variable 1Hz to 120Hz refresh rate. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is powered by the octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, which is built on a 2nm process. On the other hand, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is powered by Apple’s latest A20 Pro chipset, which is also built on a 2nm process.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max vs iPhone 18 Pro Max: The Ultimate Price in India and Specifications Comparison

description: HSBC is gradually introducing its Hong Kong dollar-pegged RedCoin stablecoin to more than 3.3 million PayMe users, enabling peer-to-peer transfers and payments at supported merchants. The bank plans to integrate RedCoin into its mobile banking app by the end of 2026, allowing customers to access tokenised investment products. The first offering is expected to be a Hong Kong dollar money market fund with a minimum subscription of HK$100.
title: HSBC Unveils RedCoin Stablecoin, Plans HK$100 Tokenised Fund Investments

description: Wireless earbuds under Rs. 20,000 now offer features such as active noise cancellation, spatial audio, high-resolution audio support and multipoint connectivity. This roundup covers five options from JBL, Samsung, Sennheiser, Apple and Sony, with different approaches to sound and everyday use. The JBL Tour Pro 3 features a touchscreen charging case, while the Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro support head gestures. The Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 4 focus on high-resolution playback, and the Apple and Sony models offer their own noise control and audio features.
title: Best Earbuds Under Rs 20,000 in India From JBL, Samsung, Apple, Sony and Sennheiser

description: There are multiple flagship and foldable smartphones that are offered with 1TB of storage in India in 2026. For reference, the iPhone 18 Pro was launched in India and other global markets on September 9 as the flagship handset from Apple, positioned below the iPhone 18 Pro Max, which features a larger battery and a bigger display. The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is the most premium Galaxy S series phone from the South Korean tech giant. The smartphone gets a redesigned rear camera unit, with a 200-megapixel primary shooter. Like the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone Duo is offered with up to 2TB of internal storage. It gets a dual 48-megapixel rear camera system.
title: Best Smartphones with 1TB Storage in India (2026): iPhone Duo, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and More
